evidence_items.locator: Abstract; methods and task analysis in the May 21, 2025 version
evidence_items.explanation: The documented agent edits files and executes commands to resolve real repository issues, with released methods and assets. The accompanying analysis reports multistep successful trajectories and nonzero success even on tasks rated hard, contradicting unavoidable failure under the stated reading.

evidence_items.locator: Original article, discussion of current capabilities before the task-length analysis
evidence_items.explanation: METR reports severe reliability limits, including success below 10% on tasks taking humans more than about four hours, while also reporting some successes on tasks taking experts hours. This supports Marcus's broader concern about reliability, but not inevitable failure.

unresolved_gaps: Marcus does not identify a task class or complexity threshold that would distinguish his claim from ordinary unreliability.
